storage.local_file_adapter: private/application-question-preferences.json; optional ESCAPEHATCH_PREFERENCES_FILE override; same schema, explicit Save/Clear, no remote sync

scopes.profile_preference: stable or user-decided value reused until changed, subject to question confirmation policy
scopes.opportunity_override: value chosen for one opportunity, such as compensation
scopes.session_confirmation: current confirmation for legal/compliance or other per-application facts

application_privacy_acknowledgement.persistence: browser-local and existing private local-file preference adapter; not public Git
application_privacy_acknowledgement.behavior: After a one-time user opt-in, check only a recognizable routine employer applicant-privacy notice, verify native checked state, and preserve any applicant uncheck on repeated Prepare in the same browser session.
application_privacy_acknowledgement.evidence: Actual employer-browser acceptance remains unproven until installed Windows runtime testing.

extension_bridge.transport: trusted Chrome MV3 popup -> service worker -> fixed-ID native messaging host; not website messaging
extension_bridge.bootstrap: onInstalled/onStartup refresh from paired owner workspace; absent host or owner binding means disabled, not implicit consent
extension_bridge.readback: signed-in bound native profile must return current boolean and revision; writes compare full local preference revision under existing transaction lock
extension_bridge.mobile: shared semantic setting exposed by responsive extension panel where extension/native messaging is supported; unsupported browsers have no automatically enabled consent
extension_bridge.runtime: enabled flag gates only recognized applicant privacy checkbox Fill Plan items; manual uncheck and Undo remain preserved
extension_bridge.proof_ceiling: repository and CI only until actual installed Chrome/Android sessions are observed
